## Checklist

- [ ] I read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] This targets `develop`, not `main`
- [ ] If this adds service-specific logic, it's implemented as a plugin,
      not a change to `js/core/` or `js/engine/`
- [ ] I ran the app locally (`index.html`) and verified it still loads
      with no console errors
- [ ] I ran the smoke test described in
      [`docs/developer-guide.md`](../docs/developer-guide.md#testing), or
      an equivalent manual check, for any `js/` changes
- [ ] I updated `README.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` / `docs/architecture.md` /
      `docs/roadmap.md` if this change affects them
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
